CAMERA CONNECTIONS

Your cameras

One camera can run at a time on this Pi. Detection pauses while ADAM processes voice requests. Previews update every few seconds; video is not recorded.

Add camera

Use the camera's private LAN IPv4 address and low-resolution substream. Credentials are saved on the Pi and are never returned to this page.

Saves the triggering frame and debugging details for action and detection-only events. Snapshots stay on the Pi for up to 7 days within the latest 200 events (at most 40 MB of images). Turning this off stops new snapshots; existing images can be deleted below.

Gesture rules

Choose a gesture, then a device and its action. Start with detection-only to check camera placement. Remove your hand for one second before making a gesture, and between repetitions.

Device choices come from Home Assistant. Import and enable a device there to use it here.

Detection settings

Recent gesture events

“Detected” means no action was enabled. Failed commands are not retried automatically.
